_note: Standing dispatch rules of the synthetic mine. Part of the synthetic dataset, not real site data. Rule LOADER-BACKUP-02 was validated by the project owner (a mining operations consultant) on 2026-10-23.

rules.text: There is no spare loader on shift. When a loader fails, cover the affected stope by reassigning the loader from the lowest-grade stope.

Stopes in a combined cycle (phase with drilling or fill, e.g. 'carguio-perforacion' or 'relleno-carguio') keep their loader, because pulling it stalls the drill or fill sequence. Only stopes in phase 'carguio' (loading only) can give up their loader.
Moving a loader to another level through the ramp takes about 1 h; within the same level about 0.5 h.
